20686.ins: Sheer polyester over a jumpsuit-and-apron construction puts the cow print in lingerie weight rather than costume weight - the apron identifies maid, the print identifies cow, and the fabric decides the room. One size at 85-130 lbs.
20686.short: Sheer cow-print maid outfit with jumpsuit and apron, one size for 85-130 lbs, playful animal-print costume as pictured.

22021.ins: The S-M-L run with lbs-based bands is the friendlier chart format for buyers who think in pounds, and the split skirt is the design decision that separates this from the office-costume defaults. Black throughout, three pieces.
22021.short: Black hip-baring secretary set with split skirt, top and thong in S to L by weight, 85-140 lbs, three-piece costume.

22022.ins: Mesh skirts photograph like costume and move like fabric, and the bodysuit underneath carries the fit so the skirt can afford its sheerness. Lace tassel detailing along the hem, with three sizes by lbs bands for the buyers past one-size ranges.
22022.short: Black sheer mesh maid outfit with headdress, bodysuit and bracelet in lace tassel styling, S to L for 85-140 lbs.

22056.ins: The waist seal converts shirt-and-skirt into a tutor silhouette - without it the set reads generic office, with it the genre lands. M runs to 125 lbs and L to 145, the heavier band most two-size listings quietly skip.
22056.short: Black tutor uniform set with shirt, short skirt and waist seal in polyester, M and L for 85-145 lbs, three pieces.

22074.ins: The combat-agent genre gives the costume category an action entry to balance its nurse-and-maid defaults - all black, structured through the bodice, dress-and-thong construction. One size at 85-130 lbs, as-pictured styling.
22074.short: Black combat agent uniform with dress and thong in dark polyester styling, one size for 85-130 lbs, action-genre two-piece set.

22081.ins: Every bunny element arrives in one bag - ears, tail, bracelet - with the plush finish separating this from the satin and lace majority. The S cut at 85-105 lbs is labeled honestly; check it against the site's other bunny listings before choosing.
22081.short: White plush bunny set with bra, panties, tail, rabbit-ear cap and bracelet, five pieces, S size for 85-105 lbs.

19295.ins: The cheongsam collar and closure construction hold the line that separates cheongsam from red dress, and the Christmas colorway is seasonal rather than structural - the silhouette works in any month the occasion demands. M and L by weight band.
19295.short: Red Christmas Chinese cheongsam with matching thong in polyester, M and L sizes for 40-65 kg, holiday colorway costume.

19729.ins: Double-layer mesh is the construction that lets a qipao read as a dress with intentions rather than as lingerie - one layer would be transparent, two read as design. The high split follows the Chinese-style reference, and three colorways span formal to classic.
19729.short: Double-mesh qipao with high split in black, white or red lace, one size for 40-60 kg, Chinese-style costume with three colorways.

19730.ins: Jacquard is woven rather than printed, which is why the pattern holds its definition at every distance - the technical difference that separates this from the print qipaos in the family. Black or white, one size for 40-60 kg.
19730.short: Hollow-out jacquard qipao in black or white woven polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, Chinese-style costume with woven pattern.

20040.ins: Two colorways of the same two-piece kit: white for the classic reference, black for the modern interpretation, and both arrive with the hat that confirms the read. One size for 40-60 kg, polyester that washes cold and dries overnight.
20040.short: Nurse role-play set with dress and hat in black or white polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, two-piece set in classic or modern colorway.
